problems.reason: The claim that Teviornis is the oldest known neognath bird contradicts the fact that Vegavis, dated to about 66 Ma, is older and also a neognath.

notes: - contradiction: "Teviornis holds the distinction of being the oldest known neognath bird, a group that includes all modern birds, alongside the species Vegavis.": The claim that Teviornis is the oldest known neognath bird contradicts the fact that Vegavis, dated to about 66 Ma, is older and also a neognath.
